items.title: How Record Revenue but Softer Margins and Buyback Pause Will Impact Norfolk Southern (NSC) Investors
items.summary: Norfolk Southern’s recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showed revenue rising to US$3,465 million from US$3,110 million a year earlier, while net income and diluted EPS from continuing operations eased to US$734 million and US$3.26, compared with US$768 million and US$3.41 respectively. items.title: Canadian National Railway (TSX:CNR) Secures North America Access Deal With Union Pacific
items.summary: Canadian National Railway (TSX:CNR) and Union Pacific signed an operating rights agreement granting each company key access across North America. The arrangement provides Canadian National Railway with improved reach between Canada, the U.S. Midwest, and Mexico. Union Pacific gains a congestion free bypass around Chicago as part of the agreement. items.title: Industrial Stocks And This ETF Claw Gains From A Falling Market
items.summary: Industrial stocks bucked a falling market on Thursday. The State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR ETF popped back into in a buy zone, led by gap-ups and breakouts for CSX, RTX and others. Many holdings in this exchange traded fund delivered blowout earnings this week.
